title: Text built from parts
prompt: Return a sentence like "Tim has 100 hp" from a name and a number. A number cannot be joined to text directly; it has to be turned into text first.
signature: func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
starter:
func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
	return name
hint: str() turns a number into text you can join with +.
solution:
func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
	return name + " has " + str(hp) + " hp"
